This meat dish has been wrapped in fragrant leaves and steamed to preserve its moisture.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Steamed Meats can be [[Cooking|Cooked]] by combining a piece of [[Meat]] with any [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]], with the exception of [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s, in a [[Cooking Pot]]. To make the default version, [[Hyrule Herb]]s must be used, as they do not provide any [[Added Effect]]s. Eating these [[Meal]]s will heal several of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. The method of preparation used on these Meats preserves their moisture. Depending on the Vegetables, herbs, or Flowers used, as well as the presence of extra Ingredients, Link can make the following variations of Steamed Meat: * '''Hearty Steamed Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Steamed Meat}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
This meat dish has been wrapped in fragrant leaves and steamed to preserve its moisture.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Radish]]es, [[Big Hearty Radish]]es, or other hearty Ingredients. When eaten, they restore all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Energizing Steamed Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Steamed Meat}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
This meat dish has been wrapped in fragrant leaves and steamed to preserve its moisture.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using energizing Ingredients. They can be eaten to replenish a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Enduring Steamed Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Steamed Meat}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This meat dish has been wrapped in fragrant leaves and steamed to preserve its moisture.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Carrot]]s or other enduring Ingredients. Link's Stamina Wheel will be completely restored and overfilled when he eats them. * '''Hasty Steamed Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Steamed Meat}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This meat dish has been wrapped in fragrant leaves and steamed to preserve its moisture.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Swift Carrot]]s, [[Swift Violet]]s, or other hasty Ingredients. By eating them, Link's movement speed will be increased. * '''Spicy Steamed Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Steamed Meat}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
This meat dish has been wrapped in fragrant leaves and steamed to preserve its moisture.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Warm Safflina]]s or other spicy Ingredients. They'll grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] if they're eaten. * '''Electro Steamed Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Steamed Meat}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
This meat dish has been wrapped in fragrant leaves and steamed to preserve its moisture.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Electric Safflina]]s or other electric Ingredients. If consumed, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Steamed Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Steamed Meat}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
This meat dish has been wrapped in fragrant leaves and steamed to preserve its moisture.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Thistle]]s or other mighty Ingredients. Eating them will provide Link with a boost to his attack power. * '''Tough Steamed Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Steamed Meat}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This meat dish has been wrapped in fragrant leaves and steamed to preserve its moisture.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Armoranth]]s or other tough Ingredients. Link can eat these meats to receive a boost to his defense. * '''Sneaky Steamed Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Steamed Meat}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
This meat dish has been wrapped in fragrant leaves and steamed to preserve its moisture.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Blue Nightshade]]s, [[Silent Princess]]es, or other sneaky Ingredients. By eating them, Link's [[Stealth]] will be increased. * '''Chilly Steamed Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Steamed Meat}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
This meat dish has been wrapped in fragrant leaves and steamed to preserve its moisture.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Cool Safflina]]s or other chilly Ingredients. These meats will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] when he eats them. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Steamed Meats return in {{TotK}}. Like in {{BotW}}, they can be made by [[Cooking]] any [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]] with a piece of [[Meat]]. However, neither variety of [[Pumpkin]] can be used to make them. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} Steamed Meat appears in {{AoC}} as an unlockable [[Recipe]]. The Recipe is obtained by completing the [[Side Quest]] "[[Hot Meals in a Pot]]". Steamed Meat boosts the [[Warrior]]'s damage by 5% when cooked before the start of a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]]. It is made using three [[Hyrule Herb]]s and three pieces of [[Raw Meat]].{{Fact}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Steamed Meat Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Steamed Meat icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Meat-Stuffed Pumpkin }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
